Color Formats

Named colors: red text on yellow background
Hex colors: #00ff00 text on #0000ff background
Short hex: #f00 text on #0f0 background
RGB: rgb(255, 255, 0) text on rgb(128, 0, 128) background
RGBA: rgba with full opacity text on semi-transparent background
HSL: hsl(0, 100%, 50%) text on hsl(120, 100%, 50%) background
HSLA: hsla with opacity
Transparent background (inherits from parent)

Nested colors

Parent: blue on lightgray
Child: green on white (overrides parent)
Back to parent color
